pretreatments.description: Cutting municipal waste into particulates using a cutter and grinding into small fine particles (lower than 4 mm) by a home type coffee grinder.
Dilution of cow manure and grinded kitchen waste with tap water to reach a concentration near the municipal waste concentration.
Co-digestion with different amounts of NaOH (0–4%) and H_2O_2 (0–4%) under mesophilic conditions (35 ± 1 °C) for 40 days.
Anaerobic stabilization with N_2 99% injection for 5 min, followed by 5 days of anaerobic digestion.
Treatment with NaOH and H_2O_2, with different amounts (0–4%) of NaOH and H_2O_2 in total weight.
